Before changing airflow or hours, determine why ventilation is required. Trace outdoor-air supply, exhaust, distribution, filtration, fans, and control logic. Where acceptable, occupancy-based control may reduce unnecessary conditioning and fan use. Heat recovery may transfer some energy from exhaust air to the incoming stream. Utility data cannot by itself establish that less outdoor air would meet health, process, or code requirements.
